inventory_entries.title: Residency in Anesthesiology and Critical Care
PhD in Science, Engineering and Technology

study_options.name: Ph.D. in Geosciences
study_options.study_description: Advanced research in petroleum/mineral exploration and development, environmental geosciences, and energy transition.

study_options.name: Residency in Neurology
study_options.study_description: One year of Internal Medicine, followed from PGY2 by three years of Neurology, inpatient/outpatient clinical care and clinical/translational research.

study_options.name: Residency in Hematology
study_options.study_description: Three years of NU Internal Medicine followed by two years of Hematology; clinical/laboratory hematology and stem-cell transplantation. Completion of NU three-year Internal Medicine allows continuation into the specialty stage.

study_options.name: Residency in Endocrinology
study_options.study_description: Three years of NU Internal Medicine followed by two years of Endocrinology including diabetes, thyroid, pituitary/hypothalamic and endocrine genetic disease. NU Internal Medicine completion permits specialty continuation.

study_options.name: Residency in Medical Oncology
study_options.study_description: Three years of NU Internal Medicine followed by two years of oncology, solid tumors, brain tumors, imaging, pathology, oncohematology, marrow transplant and palliative care. NU Internal Medicine completion permits specialty continuation.

study_options.name: Residency in Gastroenterology
study_options.study_description: Three years of NU Internal Medicine followed by three years of Gastroenterology, hepatology, liver transplant, endoscopy, imaging and research; curriculum continuation must be distinguished from a separate external application.

study_options.name: Residency in Pediatric Surgery
study_options.study_description: Two initial years in general surgical specialties, ICU/anesthesia, vascular/thoracic/emergency cardiac/trauma/ambulatory surgery; three further years concentrate on pediatric surgery.

study_options.name: Residency in Psychiatry
study_options.study_description: First year covers family medicine, neurology, inpatient psychiatry and substance-use disorders; second year inpatient psychiatric specialties; third year longitudinal outpatient specialty clinics and psychotherapy.

study_options.name: Residency in Ophthalmology
study_options.study_description: First-year emergency/consults, optometry, medicine/endocrinology, neurology/imaging and genetics; progressive ophthalmic subspecialty, ocular surgery, outpatient and inpatient training thereafter.

study_options.name: Residency in Family Medicine
study_options.study_description: Primary-care and hospital rotations in medicine, pediatrics, gynecology and surgery; progressively independent and supervisory roles, quality-improvement/research, senior electives and rural/urban community opportunities.

study_options.name: Residency in Pediatrics
study_options.study_description: Two years across inpatient pediatric specialties and outpatient care followed by senior supervisory, primary care, elective and research-focused training.

study_options.name: Residency in Obstetrics and Gynecology
study_options.study_description: Four postgraduate years of obstetric/gynecological inpatient and outpatient rotations, reproductive endocrinology/infertility, ultrasound/colposcopy, antepartum and oncology care; increasing surgical and supervisory responsibility.

study_options.name: Residency in Internal Medicine
study_options.study_description: Three years of inpatient and ambulatory Internal Medicine and subspecialty rotations with progressive supervision, clinical responsibility and research; foundation for later fellowship or listed extended subspecialty pathways.

study_options.name: Residency in General Surgery
study_options.study_description: Five years of graded general surgical responsibility, critical-care/emergency exposure, transplant/vascular/thoracic/GI and oncology/endocrine surgery; senior chief and consultant-level development.

study_options.name: Residency in Anesthesiology and Critical Care
study_options.study_description: Intern year, two junior clinical-anesthesia years and senior subspecialty/critical-care training; operating room, labour/delivery, intensive care and pain care with scholarly research.

study_options.name: Residency in Urology
study_options.study_description: Two years of general surgical/ICU/emergency/vascular/trauma/outpatient rotations followed by three years of urology, including oncology, transplant, pediatric, reconstructive, functional and endourological practice.

study_options.name: Residency in Radiology
study_options.study_description: Three years across diagnostic radiology subspecialties, PET/CT/MRI and ultrasound, followed by two years broad general radiology; final-year two six-week specialty electives.

study_options.name: Residency in Orthopaedics and Traumatology
study_options.study_description: Two-year common surgical, ICU, vascular, trauma, plastic/burn and musculoskeletal imaging trunk, then three years of progressively independent orthopaedics/trauma specialty rotations.

study_options.name: Residency in Anatomic Pathology
study_options.study_description: Three years of rotational laboratory training in autopsy, minimally invasive tissue sampling, cytopathology, surgical pathology and intraoperative consultations. The page cites 36-month AP standards; the referenced 48-month combined AP/CP standard does not establish a separate NU combined program.

study_options.name: Ph.D. in Chemistry
study_options.study_description: Four-year, 240 ECTS doctorate; options include nanotechnology, environmental science, drug design, and sponsor-based Industry PhD.

study_options.name: Ph.D. in Mathematics
study_options.school: School of Computing and Artificial Intelligence
study_options.study_description: Four-year, 242 ECTS research doctorate; 204 ECTS thesis.

study_options.name: Ph.D. in Physics
study_options.study_description: Independent research plan and doctoral thesis plus classical mechanics, quantum mechanics, statistical mechanics, solid-state physics, mathematical methods, relativity and optoelectronics courses.

study_options.name: Ph.D. in Computer Science
study_options.school: School of Computing and Artificial Intelligence
study_options.study_description: Four-year, 240 ECTS research across AI, intelligent systems, analytics, computing systems, security, and smart cities.

study_options.name: PhD in Mining Engineering
study_options.study_description: Year 1 Research Methods and Ethics, Advanced Mine Geomechanics, Advanced Mining Systems and literature analysis; thesis research throughout four years. Research covers rock mechanics, mining systems, automation, health/safety and sustainability.

study_options.name: PhD in Petroleum Engineering
study_options.study_description: Year 1 Research Methods and Ethics, Advanced Well Engineering, Advanced Reservoir Engineering, literature analysis and thesis research; independent research and doctoral thesis thereafter.

study_options.name: PhD in Science, Engineering and Technology
study_options.study_description: Research in energy, ICT, materials, sustainability, biomedical engineering, robotics and mechatronics; Level-8 courses plus thesis research.

study_options.name: Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering
study_options.study_description: Independent thesis research with Level-8 coursework and Advanced Chemical Engineering Thermodynamics. Research includes energy generation/storage, environmental remediation, hydrocarbon/plastics/food processing, bioprocesses and biotechnology.

study_options.name: Ph.D. in Robotics Engineering
study_options.school: School of Computing and Artificial Intelligence
study_options.study_description: Research in intelligent systems, industrial automation, human-robot interaction and medical/rehabilitation robotics; robotics electives and thesis.

study_options.name: Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering
study_options.study_description: Thesis research and advanced electives in energy, biomedical engineering, design/manufacturing/control, transportation and sustainability.

study_options.name: Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering
study_options.study_description: Thesis research; power engineering, electronics, signal processing/communications, biomedical engineering, mechatronics and computing. Electives include modelling/control, algorithms, signal processing, electronic circuits and VLSI fabrication.

study_options.name: Ph.D. in Civil Engineering
study_options.study_description: Research in structural/materials, geotechnical, environmental, construction management, transportation, and water resources/management; Level-8 courses and thesis.
